description: Compiles and runs F0605A (06-05, subprocedures: dcl-proc tax calc, dcl-pr extpgm CALLP against R0409A, QCMDEXC/SNDPGMMSG), F0606A (06-06, string/date BIFs), F0607A (06-07, DS/array %LOOKUP over SHOHIM/ZAIKOM, read-only), F0608A (06-08 'ZAHIK4', likerec/%kds stock allocation over ZAIKOM), and F0609A (06-09, monitor/on-error/on-exit/psds around a deliberate zero-division). Merged from two originally separate batches (05-08 and 09) per advisor review, since both were already compile+run-only with no other reason to spend a separate connection. Per this session's own design revision, F0609A's record-lock demonstration was deliberately moved OUT of the automated pipeline (a real 2-session lock-contention test cannot be reproduced within one verify/ connection) and is left as a 5250x2 manual exercise for the lesson text, same as 06-11b already does - this manifest only exercises F0609A's zero-division/monitor/on-error/psds path. F0605A/F0606A/F0609A report via SNDPGMMSG/QMHSNDPM to the job log (not DSPLY, which needs an interactive job - see each source file's own header), so VFYLOG's automatic job-log dump captures every result with no extra collect step. 2026-09-26 correction (advisor-flagged gap): F0607A and F0608A do NOT follow this pattern - both directly `dcl-f qsysprt printer(132) usage(*output)` (confirmed by grep, f0607s.rpgle:137/f0608s.rpgle:186), so their own printed output was never captured by this manifest until now. Added VSPLPF (the same CHKOBJ+conditional-CRTPF VFYSPL idiom already used in part06-12/part06-1314/part06-14b, since CRTPF has no REPLACE parameter) plus a CPYSPLF FILE(QSYSPRT) step after each of F0607A/F0608A, and a matching collect. IMPORTANT SIDE EFFECT: F0605A calls R0409A (ZAHIK3), decrementing the shared ZAIKOM row P00001 (45 -> 43 on a fresh run); F0608A's default run (WRITE/DELETE demo gated off by its own runWriteDeleteDemo indicator, per its header) also does a real CHAIN+UPDATE against ZAIKOM. Both sources' own headers already require TXRESET afterward. 2026-09-26 addition: this manifest now runs TXRESET itself at the end (`&LIB/TXRESET LIB(&LIB)` - a library-qualified command invocation, not `CALL PGM`, so it resolves at CL-compile time via the explicit qualifier rather than needing <library> in the compiling job's own library list; TXRESET is a pre-existing, already hardware-confirmed *CMD, docs/probes.md:219, so no chicken-and-egg risk like JUCINQ's), plus a collect reading ZAIKOM back afterward as end-of-batch evidence that the reset actually took effect - closing the gap where this used to require a separate, manually-remembered follow-up step before 06-07's own exercise, 06-11b, or 06-15's checkpoint could trust ZAIKOM/SHOHIM again.

steps.label: VSPLPF
steps.cmd:
CHKOBJ OBJ(&LIB/VFYSPL) OBJTYPE(*FILE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF9801) EXEC(CRTPF FILE(&LIB/VFYSPL) RCDLEN(133) TEXT('Part 6 spooled-file text capture'))

steps.label: CAPF0607A
steps.cmd: CPYSPLF FILE(QSYSPRT) TOFILE(&LIB/VFYSPL) SPLNBR(*LAST) JOB(*) CTLCHAR(*NONE) MBROPT(*ADD)

steps.label: CAPF0608A
steps.cmd: CPYSPLF FILE(QSYSPRT) TOFILE(&LIB/VFYSPL) SPLNBR(*LAST) JOB(*) CTLCHAR(*NONE) MBROPT(*ADD)
